name: EgoDex
summary: Tabletop human manipulation with egocentric video, tracked head and hand motion, and language annotations.
representation: ARKit world-frame skeletal SE(3) poses; language
imageAlt: EgoDex — official dataset or data-engine overview

name: HOT3D
summary: Synchronized egocentric views paired with motion-capture ground truth for hands and rigid objects.
representation: MANO / UmeTrack hands; object SE(3); Aria scene points
imageAlt: HOT3D — official dataset or data-engine overview

name: Ego4D
summary: Everyday first-person video across countries, with narrations and task-specific annotations. Additional sensors cover selected recordings.
representation: Narrations, temporal events and task-specific annotations
imageAlt: Ego4D — official dataset or data-engine overview

name: Ego-Exo4D
summary: Skilled activities recorded from synchronized first- and third-person views, with expert commentary and body and hand annotations.
representation: Ego–exo video; 3D body/hand poses; language commentary
imageAlt: Ego-Exo4D — official dataset or data-engine overview

name: Nymeria
summary: Daily full-body motion aligned with multi-device egocentric recordings and hierarchical language descriptions.
representation: Metric world-frame body trajectories; motion-language labels
notes: The main toolkit now supports NymeriaPlus; use the legacy branch for original Nymeria recordings.

name: NymeriaPlus
summary: An enriched Nymeria release with optimized full-body motion, scene objects, reconstructions, and additional wrist video and headset audio.
representation: MHR / SMPL motion; 2D / 3D boxes; object reconstructions
imageAlt: NymeriaPlus — official dataset or data-engine overview

name: HOI4D
summary: RGB-D human–object interactions with frame-wise hand pose, category-level object motion, segmentation, and reconstructed geometry.
representation: Hand / object poses, meshes, masks and action segments
imageAlt: HOI4D — official dataset or data-engine overview

name: ARCTIC
summary: Bimanual manipulation of articulated objects, with accurate hand and object meshes and dynamic contact annotations.
representation: MANO / SMPL-X motion; articulated objects; contact distances
notes: Depth visualizations on the project page are rendered geometry, not measured depth images.
imageAlt: ARCTIC — official dataset or data-engine overview

name: HoloAssist
summary: Collaborative physical tasks captured with synchronized headset sensors, conversation, and fine-grained action and intervention labels.
representation: Hand/head tracking; action, mistake and conversation labels

name: HD-EPIC
summary: Unscripted kitchen activity with dense hand, object, audio, gaze, and action annotations grounded in scene digital twins.
representation: Action segments, hand masks, object tracks and 3D scene alignment
notes: Scene geometry is an annotation source; it is not a raw depth-camera stream.
imageAlt: HD-EPIC — official dataset or data-engine overview

name: EgoPressure
summary: Egocentric RGB-D observations paired with measured touchpad pressure and multi-view optimized hand meshes.
representation: Measured pressure maps; optimized hand meshes
notes: Pressure is measured by a touchpad; the model’s predicted hand pressure is a separate derived output.

name: Touch and Go
summary: People probe everyday surfaces with a GelSight sensor while recording egocentric video, creating paired visual and tactile observations.
representation: RGB / GelSight video pairs; material and touch-onset labels

name: EgoVerse
summary: A shared human-data platform with standardized manipulation episodes, processing tools, and multi-lab human-to-robot transfer studies.
representation: Camera and hand trajectories; dense language; vendor-dependent sensors
notes: The live website and paper describe different corpus snapshots; the website reports about 80K episodes.

name: World In Your Hands
summary: Human manipulation data with calibrated visual observations, hand trajectories, language, and quality-controlled action annotations.
representation: Hand / wrist trajectories, skeletons, depth, masks and language
access: Full dataset linked on Hugging Face
notes: Depth is listed as an annotation; a raw depth-sensor stream is not assumed.

name: EgoEMG
summary: Bilateral muscle signals synchronized with egocentric video, external RGB-D, inertial sensing, and motion-capture hand labels.
representation: Hand joint angles from mocap; synchronized bilateral sEMG
access: Public release and preview via Baidu Netdisk
notes: The paper describes 10+ hours and 41 participants; the current repository reports an expanded release.
imageAlt: EgoEMG — official dataset or data-engine overview

name: Aria Digital Twin
summary: Real egocentric recordings paired with digital-twin renderings and geometric ground truth for cameras, people, objects, and scenes.
representation: Camera/object/body poses; segmentation; ground-truth depth; synthetic renderings
notes: Ground-truth depth is supplied by the digital twin, not by an Aria depth sensor.

name: DexCap
summary: Portable RGB-D and electromagnetic glove capture turns human hand motion into point-cloud observations and retargeted dexterous robot demonstrations.
representation: Glove finger positions; SLAM wrist poses; retargeted robot joints
access: Code, data and hardware guide linked
notes: The released policy uses point clouds; available capture channels are not automatically policy inputs.

name: HO-Cap
summary: Multi-view RGB-D and headset recordings with semi-automatic hand–object shape and pose annotation, avoiding a dedicated motion-capture system.
representation: Hand / object meshes and poses; segmentation labels
format: JPEG + depth PNG + NPZ / NumPy + YAML

name: DexYCB
summary: Multi-camera hand–object capture for hand pose, object pose, and robot handover research.
representation: MANO hands; YCB object poses; detection labels

name: EgoMimic
summary: A shared learning and data alignment recipe combines everyday egocentric human demonstrations with robot demonstrations.
representation: Human hand trajectories aligned with robot end-effector motion
access: Code, data and hardware links available
imageAlt: EgoMimic — official dataset or data-engine overview

name: MimicGen
summary: Object-centric demonstration adaptation expands a small seed set into many successful trajectories across new scene configurations.
representation: Simulated states, robot actions and replayable demonstrations
access: Data generation code and datasets released
license: Data: CC BY 4.0; code: NVIDIA Source Code License
notes: The paper studies 50K+ generated demos across 18 tasks; the public dataset is reported separately.
imageAlt: MimicGen — official dataset or data-engine overview

name: DexMimicGen
summary: Coordinated object-centric generation expands seed demonstrations for bimanual dexterous manipulation, including real-to-sim-to-real transfer.
representation: Bimanual arm/hand actions, simulation states and observations
license: Data: CC BY 4.0; code: NVIDIA Source Code License
imageAlt: DexMimicGen — official dataset or data-engine overview

name: RoboCasa
summary: Generative kitchen scenes, interactive household assets, and expanded robot demonstrations for learning everyday manipulation.
representation: Interactive scene assets and robot trajectories
notes: Configurable simulator outputs; availability varies by task and export.

name: RoboCasa365
summary: A larger household simulation release with atomic and composite tasks, diverse kitchens, demonstrations, and automatic per-frame subtask annotations.
representation: Robot trajectories; simulation state; subtask and language labels
notes: 600+ human-demo hours and 1,600+ synthetic-demo hours; the subtask annotation pipeline was released on 2026-10-14. Configurable simulator outputs; availability varies by task and export.
imageAlt: RoboCasa365 — official dataset or data-engine overview

name: DreamGen
summary: Video world models produce robot videos that are labeled with inferred actions to form synthetic training trajectories.
representation: Generated video paired with latent or inverse-dynamics pseudo-actions
notes: These neural trajectories contain inferred action labels, not simulator-ground-truth robot controls.
imageAlt: DreamGen — official dataset or data-engine overview

name: GenSim2
summary: Multimodal language models create articulated tasks, while planning and reinforcement-learning solvers generate demonstrations for 3D policy training.
representation: Simulated point clouds, proprioception and robot actions
access: Task creation and training code released
imageAlt: GenSim2 — official dataset or data-engine overview

name: RoboGen
summary: A propose–generate–learn cycle creates tasks, scenes, rewards, and training supervision for automated skill acquisition in simulation.
representation: Generated scene configurations, task decomposition and rewards

name: Gen2Sim
summary: Generative models create simulation assets and task rewards, enabling scalable training environments for articulated manipulation.
representation: Generated 3D assets, task specifications and reward programs

name: Isaac Lab
summary: GPU-parallel robot learning and demonstration workflows with physics, configurable sensors, and imitation-learning data generation.
representation: Simulated sensor streams, state, contacts and robot controls
imageAlt: Isaac Lab — official dataset or data-engine overview
notes: Configurable simulator outputs; availability varies by task and export.

name: ManiSkill3
summary: GPU-parallel simulation and rendering with heterogeneous scenes, demonstration collection, and reinforcement and imitation learning baselines.
scale: Paper: 12 task domains · millions of demo frames
representation: Simulated RGB-D / segmentation, state and robot actions
notes: Configurable simulator outputs; availability varies by task and export.

name: DexGraspNet
summary: Simulation-validated Shadow Hand grasp configurations synthesized at scale across diverse object geometry.
representation: Shadow Hand configurations; object geometry; grasp validation
notes: A static grasp dataset; grasp count is not a count of full manipulation trajectories.
